IC1: Symptomatic patients with heart failure (men [OR] and women) aged >18 years,

IC5: Type B natriuretic peptide (BNP) [OR] >150 pg/ml (or pro-BNP [N-terminal-proBNP] = 600 pg / ml) [OR] or if the patient was hospitalized [AND] for cardiac decompensation within the preceding 12 months, BNP [OR] >100 pg/ml (or N-terminal-proBNP = 400 pg / ml)
